members.name: keltner_channel_trend_v1
members.thesis: Keltner Channels use ATR-based envelopes which adapt to volatility better than standard deviation-based Bollinger Bands. When price sustains outside the Keltner Channel, it signals a strong trend that ATR-normalized volatility can't explain — i.e., genuine directional force. The inefficiency exists
filters: no entry first 30 min or last 30 min
prefer trades aligned with nifty 60-bar EMA direction
weaknesses: 38% win rate means 5-8 loss streaks are normal. Capital allocation must account for extended drawdowns.
In rangebound markets (60%+ of days), Keltner signals whipsaw repeatedly. ADX filter helps but lags.
ATR-based channels adapt slowly to sudden volatility changes — a sharp spike can invalidate the channel before it adjusts.
members.prior_art: Keltner Channel strategy. Chester Keltner (1960). Modern version uses EMA + ATR (Linda Raschke adaptation).

members.name: keltner_channel_reversion_v1
members.thesis: Keltner Channels use ATR-based bands around an EMA, making them more stable than Bollinger Bands (which use standard deviation and are distorted by extreme bars). When price touches the outer Keltner Channel (EMA(20) ± 2.5 * ATR(10)), it represents a 2.5 ATR deviation — a volatility-normalized extre
members.exit_stop: 1.0 * ATR(10) beyond the channel (beyond KC_lower for longs, beyond KC_upper for shorts)
filters: stronger signals when KC_mid slope is flat (range-bound); skip if KC_mid slope > 0.05% per bar (trending)
weaknesses: ATR(10) on 1-min bars is only 10 minutes of data — may not capture true intraday volatility regime
In persistent trends, price touches the channel and keeps trending — 'channel walk' is the primary failure mode
The 2.5 ATR multiplier is arbitrary; optimal multiplier varies by stock volatility profile and needs periodic recalibration

members.name: atr_channel_breakout_v1
members.thesis: Keltner Channel breakouts (close > EMA_20 + 2*ATR_20) with declining VIX signal legitimate expansion, not noise. The ATR-based channel adapts to current volatility, making breakouts more meaningful than fixed-percentage levels. Edge exists because Keltner Channels are less popular than Bollinger Ban
filters: no entries first 15 min or last 30 min
weaknesses: Channel breakout on 1-min can be noisy — many false breakouts during lunch hour
Stop at ema_20 can be far from entry if ATR is large, increasing risk per trade
In low-vol environments, channel is narrow and breakouts are frequent but meaningless
members.prior_art: Keltner Channel breakout — Chester Keltner / Linda Raschke. Well-established.
